text:
selena: FYI running into a confusing ordering bug in the react sample app when auth refresh + reconnect happen. fragments come back shuffled.
pete: which sdk/version?
selena: browser-sdk 1.0.0-alpha, sample-react v0.3. using SSE stream. repro pretty consistent.
selena: gist of console: `onmessage id=310 data=\"{\"stream\":\"x\",\"chunk\":5}\"` then `onmessage id=311 data=\"{\"stream\":\"x\",\"chunk\":3}\"`
omar: so event-id monotonic but application chunk index jumps backwards. that means server reissued older fragments on resume.
sdk-bot: note: auth-refresh flow changed 2024-09-01 (token rotation) which may affect reconnect semantics.
rachel: is this only UI reorder or final content corruption?
selena: final assembly ends up with chunks in wrong order for some runs. sometimes dedupe removes missing parts causing truncated output.
pete: immediate fix for sample app: sort collected fragments by `chunk` before render. cheap and reduces customer pain.
omar: longer-term SDK fix: hold fragments in a keyed buffer {stream,chunk} and only emit when next expected chunk seen or timeout. avoid naive sort because of multiplexed streams: we need stream id.
rachel: memory concern: streams can be thousands of chunks. implement sliding window + eviction TTL (e.g., 30s) and emit partial if gaps persist. document tradeoffs.
selena: also seeing some parse errors when `data:` lines get split by proxy. example payload chunk split across SSE frames and JSON.parse fails.
pete: add robust SSE buffer in browser sdk: accumulate until newline-delimited `

` event boundary, then parse. current implementation assumes whole chunk arrives per onmessage.
omar: add unit tests that simulate: 1) split frame, 2) reconnect with duplicates reordered, 3) missing chunk timeout. run under node and browser CI.
sdk-bot: creating ticket SDK-1249 for SSE parse robustness and SDK-1250 for resume-buffering.
rachel: add a small debug flag `SSE_CAPTURE_VERBOSE=true` to sample apps so support can request logs. very helpful for customers.
selena: I'll open a sample-app PR to sort fragments for rendering + enable verbose logs behind a flag. then SDK PR for buffered reassembly.
pete: tag @omar for review on buffer TTL/mechanism. and @rachel for UX on partial output fallback messaging.
omar: one more note: when auth refresh occurs, client should include both old last-event-id and resume-token header if available so server can choose deterministic re-shard path. I'll file a platform issue to discuss server-side behavior.
selena: thanks all. saved repro + HAR in thread. :sparkles:
